name: Fist of the First Men
description: An ancient ringfort atop a hill beyond the Wall, used by the Night's Watch as a ranging camp. Site of a devastating White Walker attack.

name: Castle Black
description: The primary headquarters of the Night's Watch, built into the southern side of the Wall. Home to the Lord Commander.

name: Queenscrown
description: An abandoned village tower north of the Wall, rising from a small lake. Jon Snow and the wildlings sheltered here during their ranging.

name: Eastwatch-by-the-Sea
description: An eastern Night's Watch castle where the Wall meets the Shivering Sea. The Wall was breached near here by the Army of the Dead.

name: Shadow Tower
description: A Night's Watch castle at the western end of the Wall, near the Gorge. One of only three still garrisoned castles on the Wall.

name: Last Hearth
description: Seat of House Umber, the northernmost castle in the Seven Kingdoms. Overrun and destroyed by the Army of the Dead during the Long Night.

name: Karhold
description: Seat of House Karstark in the far north. The Karstarks betrayed the Starks during the War of the Five Kings.

name: The Dreadfort
description: Grim seat of House Bolton, notorious for their practice of flaying enemies. Where Theon Greyjoy was held and broken by Ramsay Bolton.

name: Winterfell
description: Ancient seat of House Stark and capital of the North. One of the oldest castles in Westeros and site of the Battle of Winterfell against the Dead.

name: Torrhen's Square
description: Seat of House Tallhart in the North. Captured by Theon Greyjoy during the War of the Five Kings as a distraction.

name: Castle Cerwyn
description: Seat of House Cerwyn, close to Winterfell. House Cerwyn was wiped out by Ramsay Bolton for refusing to pay tribute.

name: Barrowton
description: The largest town in the North, seat of House Dustin. Built near the ancient burial mounds of the First Kings of Winter.

name: White Harbor
description: The only true city in the North and seat of House Manderly. The largest port in the North, on the mouth of the White Knife river.

name: Moat Cailin
description: Ancient ruined fortress controlling the only passage into the North by land. Held by ironborn until Ramsay Bolton retook it.

name: Oldcastle
description: A coastal town in the North along the Bay of Seals, seat of House Locke.

name: Ramsgate
description: A northern coastal town on the Bay of Seals, seat of House Ryswell.

name: Widow's Watch
description: A castle on the eastern coast of the North overlooking the Shivering Sea, seat of House Flint.

name: Flint's Finger
description: A cape and castle on the western coast of the North, seat of House Flint of Flint's Finger.

name: The Twins
description: Twin castles of House Frey straddling the Green Fork of the Trident. Site of the infamous Red Wedding.

name: Seagard
description: Coastal seat of House Mallister in the Riverlands, built to defend against ironborn raids.

name: Windish Town
description: A town in the Riverlands near the coast.

name: Pyke
description: Seat of House Greyjoy on the Iron Islands. A bleak fortress built on sea stacks battered by the ocean.

name: Bloody Gate
description: The only passage through the Mountains of the Moon into the Vale of Arryn. An almost impregnable fortification.

name: The Eyrie
description: Seat of House Arryn, perched high in the Mountains of the Moon. Home of the sky cells and the Moon Door.

name: Runestone
description: Seat of House Royce in the Vale, one of the oldest and most powerful houses sworn to the Arryns.

name: Gulltown
description: The largest city in the Vale and its main port, on the shore of the Bay of Crabs.

name: Wickendon
description: Seat of House Waxley in the Vale of Arryn.

name: Stone Hedge
description: Seat of House Bracken in the Riverlands, longtime rivals of House Blackwood of Raventree Hall.

name: Raventree Hall
description: Seat of House Blackwood in the Riverlands, home to an ancient dead weirwood tree said to be 10,000 years old.

name: Riverrun
description: Ancestral seat of House Tully at the junction of the Red Fork and Tumblestone rivers. A castle surrounded on three sides by water.

name: The Crag
description: Seat of the impoverished House Westerling on the western coast. Robb Stark married Jeyne Westerling here, breaking his oath to House Frey.

name: Faircastle
description: Seat of House Farman on Fair Isle, off the western coast of the Westerlands.

name: Ashemark
description: Seat of House Marbrand in the Westerlands, sworn to House Lannister.

name: Golden Tooth
description: A Lannister stronghold guarding the main pass through the hills into the Westerlands.

name: Hornvale
description: Seat of House Brax in the Westerlands, sworn to Casterly Rock.

name: Pinkmaiden
description: Seat of House Piper in the Riverlands, on the Red Fork of the Trident.

name: Acorn Hall
description: Seat of House Smallwood in the Riverlands.

name: High Heart
description: A hill in the Riverlands with 31 weirwood stumps, sacred to the children of the forest. Home to a mysterious woods witch.

name: Harrenhal
description: The largest castle in Westeros, melted and ruined by Balerion the Black Dread during Aegon's conquest. Said to be cursed.

name: Maidenpool
description: Seat of House Mooton in the Riverlands, on the shore of the Bay of Crabs.

name: Claw Isle
description: Seat of House Celtigar in the narrow sea, loyal bannermen of the Targaryens.

name: Dragonstone
description: Ancient Targaryen stronghold on an island in Blackwater Bay. Birthplace of Daenerys Targaryen and seat of dragon power.

name: Antlers
description: Seat of House Buckwell in the Crownlands.

name: Stoney Sept
description: A town in the Riverlands where Robert Baratheon nearly died during the Rebellion. Site of the Battle of the Bells.

name: Deep Den
description: Seat of House Lydden in the Westerlands, a castle carved into a hillside.

name: Casterly Rock
description: Ancestral stronghold of House Lannister, overlooking the Sunset Sea. Said to be impregnable, hollowed out of a great stone hill.

name: Clegane's Keep
description: Seat of House Clegane in the Westerlands, bannermen to the Lannisters. Home of Sandor and Gregor Clegane.

name: Feastfires
description: Seat of House Prester in the Westerlands.

name: Rosby
description: Seat of House Rosby in the Crownlands, close to King's Landing.

name: King's Landing
description: The capital of the Seven Kingdoms and seat of the Iron Throne. Home of the Dragonpit where Targaryen dragons were kept.

name: Silverhill
description: Seat of House Serrett in the Westerlands.

name: Cornfield
description: Seat of House Swyft in the Westerlands, sworn to Casterly Rock.

name: Crakehall
description: Seat of House Crakehall in the Westerlands. Jaime Lannister squired here in his youth.

name: Old Oak
description: Seat of House Oakheart in the Reach, sworn to Highgarden.

name: Red Lake
description: A lake in the Reach near the seat of House Crane.

name: Goldengrove
description: Seat of House Rowan in the Reach, one of the most powerful houses sworn to the Tyrells.

name: Tumbleton
description: A town in the Reach, site of two major battles during the Dance of the Dragons.

name: Bitterbridge
description: A town in the Reach where the roseroad crosses the Mander. Site of a massacre during the War of the Five Kings.

name: Grassy Vale
description: Seat of House Meadows in the Reach.

name: Felwood
description: Seat of House Fell in the Stormlands.

name: Long Table
description: Seat of House Mertyns in the Reach.

name: Cider Hall
description: Seat of House Fossoway in the Reach, known for its apple orchards.

name: Ashford
description: A town in the Reach on the Cockleswhent river. Site of a famous tournament in the reign of Daeron II.

name: Summerhall
description: A Targaryen pleasure palace in the Stormlands. Destroyed in a mysterious fire that killed King Aegon V.

name: Haystack Hall
description: Seat of House Cafferen in the Stormlands.

name: Bronzegate
description: Seat of House Buckler in the Stormlands.

name: Evenfall Hall
description: Seat of House Tarth on the island of Tarth. Birthplace of Brienne of Tarth.

name: Storm's End
description: Ancient seat of House Baratheon, built by Durran Godsgrief according to legend. One of the strongest castles in Westeros.

name: Griffin's Roost
description: Seat of House Connington in the Stormlands. Home of Jon Connington, exiled friend of Rhaegar Targaryen.

name: Highgarden
description: Seat of House Tyrell and the breadbasket of Westeros. The most fertile land in the Seven Kingdoms, destroyed by Jaime Lannister.

name: Brightwater Keep
description: Seat of House Florent in the Reach, given to Ser Axell Florent by Stannis Baratheon.

name: Bandallon
description: Seat of House Blackbar in the Reach.

name: Honeyholt
description: Seat of House Beesbury in the Reach, known for its beekeeping.

name: Oldtown
description: The oldest city in Westeros and home of the Citadel, where maesters are trained. Seat of House Hightower and the Faith of the Seven.

name: Blackcrown
description: Seat of House Bulwer in the Reach.

name: Uplands
description: Seat of House Mullendore in the Reach.

name: Three Towers
description: Seat of House Merrell in the Reach, on the coast of the Redwyne Straits.

name: Sun House
description: Seat of House Dalt in Dorne.

name: Starfall
description: Seat of House Dayne in Dorne, where the legendary sword Dawn is kept. Near where Ned Stark killed Arthur Dayne.

name: Blackmont
description: Seat of House Blackmont in Dorne.

name: Hornhill
description: Seat of House Tarly in the Reach. Home of Samwell Tarly and the Valyrian steel sword Heartsbane.

name: Skyreach
description: Seat of House Fowler in Dorne, in the Red Mountains.

name: Nightsong
description: Seat of House Caron in the Stormlands, on the border with Dorne.

name: Kingsgrave
description: Seat of House Manwoody in Dorne.

name: Vulture's Roost
description: An abandoned castle in the Red Mountains of Dorne, used as a base by the Vulture King during his rebellion.

name: Blackhaven
description: Seat of House Dondarrion in the Stormlands, guarding the Boneway pass into Dorne.

name: Wyl
description: Seat of House Wyl in Dorne, in the mountains near the Boneway.

name: Yronwood
description: Seat of House Yronwood, the most powerful house in Dorne after the Martells. Known as the Bloodroyal.

name: Stonehelm
description: Seat of House Swann in the Stormlands.

name: Mistwood
description: Seat of House Mercer in the Stormlands.

name: Rain House
description: Seat of House Wylde in the Stormlands.

name: Ghost Hill
description: Seat of House Toland in Dorne, on the coast of the Summer Sea.

name: Sunspear
description: Capital of Dorne and seat of House Martell. The southernmost city in Westeros, where Oberyn Martell was born.

name: Lemonwood
description: Seat of House Dalt in Dorne, near Sunspear.

name: Godsgrace
description: Seat of House Allyrion in Dorne, at the junction of the Greenblood and Vaith rivers.

name: The Tor
description: Seat of House Jordayne in Dorne.

name: Vaith
description: Seat of House Vaith in the deep desert of Dorne, on the river Vaith.

name: Salt Shore
description: Seat of House Wade in Dorne, on the coast of the Summer Sea.

name: Hellholt
description: Seat of House Uller in Dorne. Said that half the Ullers are halfmad and the other half are worse.

name: Sandstone
description: Seat of House Qorgyle in Dorne, deep in the desert.

name: Tyrosh
description: One of the Free Cities, known for its brightly dyed hair and its production of rare dyes. Sits on an island at the mouth of the Stepstones.

name: Braavos
description: The wealthiest and most powerful of the Free Cities. Home of the Iron Bank, the Faceless Men, and the Titan of Braavos.

name: Pentos
description: A Free City across the Narrow Sea where Daenerys spent her early years in exile with her brother Viserys.

name: Myr
description: A Free City famous for its fine lace and its master craftsmen in glass and optics. Jorah Mormont sold poachers into slavery here.

name: Volantis
description: The oldest and proudest of the Free Cities, at the mouth of the Rhoyne. A city of slaves and tigers, deeply corrupt.

name: Sar Mell
description: A ruined city along the Rhoyne, sacked by Valyria during the wars that destroyed the Rhoynar.

name: Volon Therys
description: A large town on the Rhoyne south of Volantis, important trading post.

name: Valysar
description: A ruined Rhoynar city along the river, destroyed during Valyria's expansion.

name: Selhorys
description: A town on the Rhoyne controlled by Volantis, far to the north of the mother city.

name: Ny Sar
description: A ruined city of the Rhoynar on the banks of the Rhoyne, long abandoned after the Valyrian wars.

name: Norvos
description: A Free City in the hills of Essos, known for its bearded priests and strict religious hierarchy.

name: Qohor
description: A Free City in the forests of Essos known for its master metalworkers, the only craftsmen who can reforge Valyrian steel.

name: Oros
description: A ruined Valyrian colony city on the southern coast of Essos.

name: Tyria
description: A ruined Valyrian outpost near the Valyrian peninsula.

name: Valyria
description: Once the greatest empire in the known world and birthplace of dragons. Destroyed in the Doom, now a smoking ruin haunted by Stone Men.

name: New Ghis
description: A slaver city rebuilt by the Ghiscari after Old Ghis was destroyed by Valyria. Part of the slaving empire that Daenerys dismantled.

name: Old Ghis
description: The ruined capital of the ancient Ghiscari Empire, destroyed by the Valyrian Freehold five thousand years ago.

name: Astapor
description: One of the three great slaver cities of Slaver's Bay. Where Daenerys bought and then freed the Unsullied using Drogon.

name: Elyria
description: A city of the Valyrian colony on the southern coast of Essos.

name: Tolos
description: A slaver city on the coast of the Gulf of Grief, allied against Daenerys.

name: Mantarys
description: A dangerous city on the demon road east of Valyria, said to be full of monsters and madmen.

name: Bhonash
description: A ruined city in Essos along the road east of Valyria.

name: Meereen
description: The greatest of the slaver cities. Where Daenerys ruled as queen and chained her dragons Rhaegal and Viserion in the catacombs.

name: Yunkai
description: The Yellow City, one of the three slaver cities. Known for training bed slaves rather than warriors. Freed by Daenerys.

name: Qarth
description: The greatest city that ever was or will be, according to its inhabitants. A wealthy trading city at the edge of the known world.

name: Bayasabhad
description: A city of the Bones in far eastern Essos, along the ancient road to Qarth.

name: Village of the Lhazareen
description: A settlement of the Lhazareen, the peaceful lamb people of the Lhazar region, raided by the Dothraki.

name: Samyrian
description: A city in the far east of Essos beyond the Bone Mountains.

name: Vaes Dothrak
description: The only city of the Dothraki, where Daenerys hatched her three dragons on Khal Drogo's funeral pyre, bringing dragons back into the world.
